remarks: Lying in the Sherwood Forest North neighborhood in the Williamsville East school district lies an exceptionally maintained 3 bed 2.5 bath 2,175 ft.² ranch that offers the convenience of first floor laundry, an attached 2 car garage with an impressively wide driveway. As you walk in, you will enter into the entry foyer that gives access to the formal sitting room to your right with an updated bay window (2019) a hallway straight ahead that will lead to your sleeping spaces, and to your left a formal dining room. Notice the bright features with the new LVP, paint, and trim having been done in 2020. As you explore 2175 ft.² of living space you will notice a beautifully open living space that includes a family room, a .5 bath, a breakfast island (2020) and a kitchen that was remodeled in 2017 with granite countertops. Off of the family room you have access to 1st floor laundry as well as the convenience of having a new gas fireplace insert (2019) to make every evening an event and an Andersen sliding glass door (2020) which will lead on to the composite deck with vinyl railings (2020). In the other half of the house you have 3 generously sized rooms and 2 additional baths with one of the three bedrooms being your primary bedroom that has a beautiful en suite. All carpet and bathrooms have been updated and were completed in 2020! Coupled with LARGE DRY basement and a brand new sump pump with a water jet back up this area is waiting to be finished! 459 Wood acres Drive has all your needs and your wants! Additional updates from 2019: Pella front storm doors. 2020: Kitchen sink. 2024: Driveway sealed, garage floor & front stoop retextured. 2026: garage door opener. Offers to be reviewed as they come in, seller has right to set deadline. Open house 10/17 11am-1pm
